title: galium mollugo var. alpinum
intro: Galium mollugo var. alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Bedstraw, is a perennial plant species within the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, providing various health benefits, including wound healing, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and combating infections. The bioactive constituents found in Alpine Bedstraw include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
